description: This PHP source file defines a class 'EditEmployeeAttendanceRecordMenuConfigurator' that implements menu configuration for the 'Edit Employee Attendance Record' feature within the OrangeHRM system. It overrides module and screen settings to customize menu behavior related to attendance records.

classes.name: EditEmployeeAttendanceRecordMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring menu options related to editing employee attendance records, overriding module and screen context for the attendance view.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the menu by overriding the current module to 'time' and the screen to 'viewAttendanceRecord'.
